site.name: Weyerhaeuser Longview — mill and log yards
site.description: Weyerhaeuser's Longview complex along the Columbia west of the Lewis and Clark Bridge: log decks, lumber yards, chip and sawdust piles and the mills themselves.
site.notes: v1 measured a square on downtown Longview (46.138, -122.937) by mistake; v2 measures the mapped mill and yard outline. Mill roofs show up as always-on area and are kept apart.
